messages:
sre-bot: Paging: error-rate spike on /assets/* from canary (svc-assets) — 5xx up to 12% over last 2m. Auto-escalation -> ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: Saw it, joining. Can everyone stop new deploys to svc-assets? 
ci-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-15T10:24:50Z for svc-assets rolled out to 5% (revision: build-20260315-7b9). Health check failing on 2/5 pods.
alexa: 5xx are nginx upstream failures, looks like asset downloads failing with 502 from storage backend. Only canary pods affected.
miguel: curling the canary pod shows large amounts of 404/502 on requests that should be cached. Running: ```kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=svc-assets -o wide``` then ```kubectl -n prod logs deploy/svc-assets-canary --tail=200```
jamie: I see docker image reported in deployment: tag "stable-latest" but imageDigest is different across nodes. suspicious.
hana: Wait - CI annotated the canary with image: repo.redwood/inference-assets:stable-latest and digest sha256:abc123 on canary-1 but sha256:def456 on canary-2. That indicates a mutable tag was reused.
ops-oncall: If the tag changed under the same label we could be mixing layers from two different builds -> cache-layer collision. That matches cross-tag asset mismatch.
product-ops: Possible customer impact? Any 500s surfaced to user-facing endpoints?
alexa: Most errors are internal asset fetches for thumbnails and model-metadata; user requests for text generation see increased latency but few direct 500s so far. Still worrying.
miguel: Running registry inspect: ```skopeo inspect docker://repo.redwood/inference-assets:stable-latest``` returns digest sha256:def456. CI claimed earlier push with abc123. There was a retry in CI due to transient network and it re-tagged a different build with same tag.
jamie: Confirmed in build logs: older build finished and pushed, then a later concurrent build (cache hit) pushed a different image with same tag. Our pipeline allowed force-push to tag 'stable-latest'.
ops-oncall: We need an immediate mitigation. Options: 1) Kill canary traffic (pause rollout), 2) Flip feature flag that routes clients to canary assets, 3) Roll the canary back to previous immutable digest. Thoughts?
hana: Flip feature flag for assets-serving to off for canary-tenants -> fastest. I can toggle the flag (ff:assets_canary=true -> false).
product-ops: Do it — reduce risk to customers.
alexa: Also pause rollout: ```kubectl -n prod rollout pause deploy/svc-assets-canary``` and scale down canary pods to 0.
miguel: Also let's trigger a rollback to the previous known-good digest: deployment image should be repo.redwood/inference-assets@sha256:aaa999. I'll prepare the manifest.
ci-bot: Notifying CI: prevent new pushes to tag stable-latest until policy is changed. Also creating job to re-push the correct immutable digest.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-42. Severity: high (potential data-quality impact). On-call: ops-oncall.
ops-oncall: Actions taken: 1) feature flag toggled by hana at 10:28 (ff-assets_canary=false), 2) rollout paused by alexa at 10:29, 3) canary scaled down by alexa at 10:30.
jamie: Applying rollback manifest now: ```kubectl -n prod set image deploy/svc-assets repo.redwood/inference-assets@sha256:aaa999 --record``` -> rollout started.
miguel: Watching pods: new pods come up with digest aaa999, healthchecks passing. No 5xx spikes after ~30s.
ops-oncall: Good. Product-ops, we should message customers who hit degraded experience in last 20 minutes. Any telemetry to identify impacted tenants?
product-ops: I can pull request logs for tenants with >5 errors in timeframe. Will coordinate comms.
hana: Quick postmortem notes: root cause = mutable tag 'stable-latest' being reused by concurrent CI pushes, causing mixed digests and cache-layer collisions. Secondary cause = lack of automatic kill-switch bound to tag policy.
alexa: Immediate follow-ups: - Enforce immutable-tagging in CI (use digest or unique build tags) - Block force-push on stable-latest OR require approvals - Add registry-side policy to reject tag overwrite - Add alert for imageDigest drift across replicas
miguel: I'll open a PR to CI pipeline to always push image with unique build-id and only move stable-latest after promotion step. Also adding a check in deploy job comparing imageDigest across nodes before marking success.
ops-oncall: Security note: Could be abused by supply-chain if tags are mutable. cc:security.
product-ops: Comms draft: short status update -> we had canary asset failures, we've rolled back canary, no broad customer outages, investigating root cause, follow-up w/ permanent fix. Will post in #general + customer incident channel.
sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> operational at 10:37. Will keep incident open until CI policy changes are deployed.
ops-oncall: Thanks all. Miguel/Jamie/Hana please coordinate follow-up action items and drop updates here. I'll handoff to next oncall at 10:45. 
jamie: handing off to @ops-oncall-next for follow-up. :wave: 
ops-oncall: Handoff noted. Ending thread for live mitigation; keep adding notes as PRs land. :thumbsup:
